headline: Pastor-Satorras-Vespignani 2001 SIS on scale-free networks: 2/3 locked clauses REPRO; BA lambda_c 0.074(1e3)->0.061(1e5) vs ER finite lambda_c=0.153; rho_BA(0.05)/rho_ER(0.05)=243; stretched-exp C=0.316 (R^2=0.988)

verdicts.gate: P1 vanishing threshold on BA: lambda_c(1e5) <= (1/3) lambda_c(1e3) AND rho_BA(0.05, N>=1e5) > 0.005
P2 homogeneous control keeps finite threshold: lambda_c in [0.125, 0.21] AND rho_homog(0.05) < 0.002 AND rho_BA(0.05)/rho_homog(0.05) >= 5
P3 stretched-exponential rho=A*exp(-C/lambda) on BA over lambda in [0.04, 0.12]: C in [0.20, 0.47] AND R^2 > 0.95

extra.framing: hybrid: network generator (BA / ER) + SIS agent dynamics on it
extra.scope: faithful hybrid reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + locked discipline reproduce the vanishing epidemic threshold on scale-free networks (contrasted against a finite threshold on a homogeneous network) and would catch an artifact

citations: Pastor-Satorras, R. & Vespignani, A. (2001). Epidemic spreading in scale-free networks. Phys. Rev. Lett. 86:3200-3203. doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.86.3200.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the threshold scaling, the BA-vs-homogeneous prevalence ratio, and the stretched-exp fit
